constraints.rule: OpenAI encrypted_content, Claude signature/redacted_thinking, Google thought_signature are opaque; return/replay source exact bytes and order bound to source/account/session; no invented/stripped signature or cross-provider substitution

prompt_cache_retention is a maximum policy while prompt_cache_options.ttl is a minimum lifetime. They need not be aliases or mutually exclusive. Preserve both; Chat12h is conditional due conflicting reference evidence, not a local hard-deny.
OpenAI auto/default/flex/priority/fast/ultrafast and Claude auto/standard_only plus speed are distinct; preserve native requested and actually served tier and bill actual source usage

native field presence is not executor support: background, store, previous_response_id, conversation, prompt templates, container and context management require ownership/lifecycle/cancellation/final accounting, else explicit unsupported

gaps: Current conversion whitelist does not enumerate all current official parameters. Native cloning is not equal to support by gateway execution/usage/session layers.
Gemini native GenerateContent is a different transport; an OpenAI-compatible Chat source is not a native Gemini adapter.
Not every current model supports every enum in the generic API schema. Registry/API version/account entitlement must stay separate.
No runtime, build, regression suite or real provider request was executed.

review_corrections.statement: Maximum retention and minimum TTL policies are distinct, but non-equivalence does not prove mutual exclusion. Preserve both native fields.
SDK/guide30m restriction conflicts with other REST evidence; mark conditional and do not hard-reject native12h solely from one reference.
